I want to send an email asking the dean why she would do this after being so supportive and sweet to me. Does she have any legal right to do this as I am an adult? I want to tell her that my trust in her has been dissolved and that my home life has become difficult due to the personal information she revealed about me. Obviously this would not help me at this point since I just graduated, but it would be cathartic. WIBTA?
